title: Silent Failure Catalog: validation that passes while nothing is being checked
description:
A catalog of silent failure modes in CI gates, test suites, data pipelines and AI-agent harnesses. Each entry names a failure pattern, gives a minimal reproduction, a self-check and a fix that carries a negative control.

The shared root cause: the absence of evidence is recorded as evidence of absence of a problem. Two mechanical consequences follow — missing must enter the exit code, and no negative control means no evidence.

License is split: MIT for the code in tools/; the prose in failures/ and docs/ is all rights reserved, with citation under attribution permitted. No entry claims conformance with any standard, and the catalog is not affiliated with any vendor or standards body.
